30th Anniversary
The Women's Prize for Fiction
The Women’s Prize Trust has spent the last 29 years supporting women writers, originally through the Women’s Prize for Fiction.
In our 30th year, let’s take a look at the previous winners of the prize, the greatest celebration of female creativity in the world.
